name: WPadmin.AI – Claude & ChatGPT: Ask, Fix & Build Within Dashboard | No MCP needed
author: WPspin LLC

sections.description:
Ask questions. Get quick guidance about your WordPress site, plugins, settings, content, WooCommerce, SEO, and common errors from the chatbox in your dashboard. Ask what to check or how something works without changing your site.

Fix problems. Build what your WordPress site needs. WPadmin.AI brings quick answers and an AI agentic interface into your WordPress dashboard. Ask the chatbox for guidance, or authorize the included Developer Add-on when you want a change made. Describe the result in everyday language; you do not need to write a line of code.

The chatbox answers questions about your site, plugins, settings, WooCommerce, content, SEO, and common errors. It gives guidance without changing your website. For changes, troubleshooting, and data analysis, use the built-in AI interface to get things done with prompts. Choose ChatGPT Codex or Claude using your own ChatGPT or Claude account.

Free and Premium

  • Free for life: Answers and guidance are quickly available through the dashboard chatbox. The included Developer Add-on lets you use prompts to investigate and make requested changes on your connected site. Free has no public staging preview.
  • Premium — $99/year: Everything in Free, including prompt-driven, no-code agent work, plus a managed staging copy to review changes before they go live and human support by email, chat, or screenshare. That is $8.25/month when billed annually.

Developer tasks have no WPadmin.AI cap; your ChatGPT or Claude account limits still apply.

Features and what they mean

  • Dashboard Q&A: Get site-aware answers and practical steps without leaving wp-admin.
  • Included Developer Add-on: Authorize the agent when you need it to investigate or make a website change.
  • Choose your agent: Use ChatGPT Codex or Claude with your own provider account.
  • Prompt-driven work: Ask for changes to pages, plugins, themes, content, settings, or site data in plain language.
  • Visible work: Follow the agent’s visible commands and output, and ask it to show the files or code it changed.
  • Production protection: Eligible file changes can use a pre-change backup and fatal-error recovery safeguard when the host supports them.
  • Premium staging and support: Review the result on a managed test copy and get human help when needed.
  • Switch running tasks between Claude and ChatGPT Codex (Premium): Contact Premium support for help with a clean switch. Both agents support /import, but the context they can import differs.

Use ChatGPT within your WordPress dashboard

Choose ChatGPT Codex and sign in with your own ChatGPT account. Ask it to inspect a plugin, build a feature, or update a page within wp-admin. No local Codex installation is needed.

Use Claude within your WordPress dashboard

Choose Claude and sign in with your own Claude account. Ask it to troubleshoot, edit code or content, analyze site data, and explain changes. No local Claude installation is needed.

No MCP or WordPress Abilities API setup needed

You do not need to create an MCP server connection or configure the WordPress Abilities API. Install the plugin, authorize the included Developer Add-on, enter your pairing token, and sign in to your chosen agent. WPadmin.AI handles the connection between your dashboard, its managed agent environment, and your WordPress site.

Built-in recovery protection

For eligible production file changes, WPadmin.AI can arm a recovery safeguard before the change. If new PHP code causes a fatal error while that safeguard is active, it can set aside the affected new files and restore their backed-up versions. This protection applies to covered file changes; it is not a full database rollback.

Built-in backups when hosting allows

Before eligible live file changes, WPadmin.AI attempts to save a backup in your site’s uploads area and manages cleanup of older backups. Availability depends on the site’s hosting permissions and storage. The agent can report whether a backup was created for the task.

Staging copy included with Premium

Premium provides a managed staging copy of your site. Let the agent work there, review the result, and then request the specific approved change on your live site. Free users work on the connected live site without a public staging preview.

See the commands and code changes

The in-dashboard agent session shows its visible commands and output as it works. Ask it to display the code it writes, the changed files, or a code diff and explain the result. You can inspect its work without having to write code yourself.

Easy to install, with no complex local setup

Install WPadmin.AI, choose a plan, and ask questions. For site changes, authorize the Developer Add-on, enter your pairing token, and sign in to ChatGPT or Claude. No local agent, API key, or MCP connector is needed.

Examples: big builds and small fixes

  • Build a marketplace, booking flow, membership area, or calculator.
  • Create a page, plugin, form, shortcode, or theme section.
  • Fix a checkout, form, booking button, plugin conflict, or PHP error.
  • Update WooCommerce products or variations from a CSV.
  • Investigate performance, caching, and SEO issues.
  • Revise page or product copy, headings, layouts, and settings.
  • Analyze posts, products, or database records for a focused change.

Works alongside popular WordPress tools

Works alongside WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, Rank Math, Gravity Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Advanced Custom Fields, Wordfence, LiteSpeed Cache, and WP Rocket, plus editors and builders such as Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, Bricks, Beaver Builder, Oxygen, WPBakery, Visual Composer, and Breakdance. Results depend on the site’s setup, permissions, and task.

Watch real WordPress tasks

Some demos use Premium staging; Free has no public staging preview.

Bulk-update WooCommerce variation prices with Claude:

More WordPress changes with AI:

Third-party services and data

The plugin needs the WPadmin.AI hosted service for account and subscription checks, pairing, chatbot responses, and the developer agentic interface. It sends your site URL, active plugin and theme names and versions, admin-page context, prompts, and any site data you choose to share. WPadmin.AI uses OpenAI to process chatbot questions.

After you authorize the included Developer Add-on, WPadmin.AI validates access, connects your dashboard to a managed agent environment, and transfers the files or database data needed for your task. Your chosen coding agent may send prompts and relevant task data to OpenAI for ChatGPT Codex or Anthropic for Claude. WPadmin.AI may retain account, prompt, and operational records as described in its Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. Provider accounts, charges, and limits are separate; see OpenAI policies and Anthropic policies.

Support

Free support: WordPress.org plugin support forum. Premium human support is available through the plugin after pairing.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WPadmin.AI from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Open Settings → AI Assistant for the WPadmin, choose Free or Premium, and complete signup.
  3. Ask WordPress questions in the dashboard chatbox. When you want a site change, authorize the included Developer Add-on from the prompt or settings page.
  4. Enter the pairing token shown in your subscription account, choose ChatGPT Codex or Claude, and sign in to your own provider account. Premium setup also prepares your staging copy.
sections.faq:
Can the chatbox change my site?

The chatbox provides answers and guidance. The included Developer Add-on needs your authorization before it can work on a site change.

Do I need MCP, the Abilities API, local software, or an API key?

No separate setup for any of these is needed. You sign in to your own ChatGPT or Claude account for the agent you choose.

Can I use the Developer Add-on on Free?

Yes. It can make requested changes to your connected live site. Free does not include a public staging preview.

What does Premium add?

Everything in Free, plus a managed staging copy for reviewing work and human support.

Is backup or recovery guaranteed?

No. WPadmin.AI attempts backups for eligible file changes and can use a fatal-error recovery safeguard when the host supports them. Keep your own independent site backups.
